steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own PS1 USA BugsBunnyLostinTime SLUS00838 disc, retained at runtime; retailBIOS not redistributed, bundled OpenBIOS default.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Local owned-input source route: initialize pinned submodules, use the documented psxrecomp_cli.py generate command on the owned BugsBunny LostinTime USA disc, then CMake/Ninja psx-runtime. Keep locally generated original-game code private; publishing is not part of setup. The separate upstream precompiled ZIP/RetroLauncher route is not managed or inspected by Portcove.
